chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from al-Hajjal, from Aban, who said:
Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام said: “Remove the hair from yourselves, for it improves [one’s condition/appearance].”
ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about removing body hair?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages removing bodily hair as part of personal grooming and refinement. In context, it reflects the etiquettes and recommended practices associated with cleanliness and the bathhouse.
